content: We set INLINEFORM0 to be the window size that the user has defined. Kappa is an agreement metric between two models. Therefore, BV2009 needs INLINEFORM1 models to be generated before it begins to check if the average is above the threshold. This does not necessarily mean it stops after INLINEFORM2 models have been generated. Rather, it represents the first point in the active learning process at which BV2009 even has a chance to stop.
